score_scale: 10-point PO story-readiness checklist; one non-blocking partial deduction

post_no_go_delta_review.reviewed_story_state: Current post-NO-GO revision, not the historical Draft snapshot
verified_additions: Tasks / Subtasks with acceptance-criteria mapping and implementation sequence
Dev Notes covering approved stack, undecided implementation choices, schema boundary, source-tree caveat, and external credentials
Testing matrix with clean-checkout setup, CLI outcomes, separate empty/already-migrated database scenarios, and expected evidence
Observable minimal CLI help and PostgreSQL connectivity behavior with distinct success/failure exit codes and credential-safe errors
Migration baseline restricted to migration-control infrastructure with no domain tables and no repeated DDL/duplicates
Executor/quality-gate assignment reconciled to the Schema/DB/Migrations mapping

decision_alignment.prd_rf_nrf: Foundation setup does not introduce business behavior or claim new FR/NFR. The PRD 0.2, RF 0.1.1, and current NRF text were checked; the story protects external credentials and defines infrastructure checks without inventing product policy.
decision_alignment.architecture: Architecture 0.1 and ADR-006/007 ratify CLI as the operational surface, PostgreSQL, and Next.js only for any future observational/read-only UI. The story correctly limits this increment to technical CLI and PostgreSQL foundation; it does not invent a CLI language/runtime, ORM, version, deployment, topology, or domain schema.
decision_alignment.constitution: Constitution Art. I is respected: the only delivered application entry point in this increment is a technical CLI, with no UI or product-operation paths; future operational journeys remain CLI-first.
decision_alignment.legacy_acceptance_criteria: AC-31 and AC-33-34 are cited only as legacy traceability. The story's scope remains foundation/bootstrap, and it does not reinstate the umbrella story as an implementation authorization.
decision_alignment.dependencies_and_sequence: No prerequisite is appropriate for story 1.2, the first implementable foundation increment listed in umbrella story 1.1. Product journeys and the later read-only UI remain outside this story.
decision_alignment.coderabbit: Core configuration explicitly disables CodeRabbit. The story records the disabled state and a manual @dev gate with @architect boundary review and @qa reproduction; no automated CodeRabbit run is implied.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Objective, actor, and value are clear
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: Title and Story statement identify the developer actor, local foundation/persistence goal, and enablement value.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Authoritative source traceability and current requirement alignment
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: Current PRD, RF, NRF, architecture/ADR-006/007, and Constitution were reviewed; story cites architecture and Constitution and declares no new FR/NFR.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Scope boundaries and MVP increment size
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: Scope is bootstrap, technical CLI, PostgreSQL, migration baseline, and reproducible setup only; domain journeys, UI, deployment, and hosted infrastructure are excluded.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Acceptance criteria are observable and testable
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: ACs specify help usage/exit 0; DB-check exit 0 on connection and non-zero on failure without credentials; migration state on empty and already-migrated DB; recorded selected versions/commands; and a local CLI-only/no-product-operations outcome.
Dependencies are explicitly none, consistent with the first implementable backlog increment; task order proceeds from bootstrap to CLI/database and end-to-end reproduction.
PostgreSQL and CLI-first operational boundary are honored; Next.js remains observational-only and is not pulled into this story.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Security, data handling, and quality gate are planned
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: Credentials stay outside version control and error output; @data-engineer executor and distinct @dev gate match the Schema/DB/Migrations matrix and include concrete validation tools.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Tasks, Dev Notes, and testing handoff enable implementation
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: All three sections now exist. Tasks map to ACs; notes explicitly avoid assuming an architecture-unratified source tree; testing lists reproducible stages and expected evidence.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Manual CodeRabbit fallback and required quality planning
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: CodeRabbit is disabled in core-config; the story records the disabled notice and manual @dev/@architect/@qa review path without automated gate tasks.

po_checklist_10_points.criterion: Self-contained executable increment with clear done evidence
po_checklist_10_points.evidence: The CLI behavior, fresh database baseline, rerun semantics, clean-checkout test sequence, and required command/exit-code/evidence recording are stated. The exact persistent evidence artifact location remains implementation/PR record rather than a named repository path; this is non-blocking because implementation choices and repository layout are intentionally not ratified.

task_validation.template_compliance: PASS for draft/readiness-required handoff sections; implementation-time Dev Agent Record and QA Results remain lifecycle artifacts, not pre-development content

executor_assignment.quality_gate_tools: Non-empty and appropriate: empty/already-migrated database migrations, schema inspection, documented install/test reproduction, CLI/PostgreSQL connection smoke test

task_validation.acceptance_criteria: PASS — locally observable outcomes with positive and negative cases, migration baseline and idempotent normal rerun, credential handling, and implementation-choice documentation
task_validation.tasks_dev_notes_testing: PASS — all present, sequenced, mapped to ACs, and usable without assuming an unratified implementation stack
task_validation.schema_domain_boundary: PASS — only migration-control infrastructure required by the selected tool; no domain tables or business rules
task_validation.migration_scenarios: PASS — distinct fresh dedicated empty database application and normal command rerun on the same migrated database; explicitly not a destructive rerun of an initial migration or an existing user database
task_validation.local_repeatable_evidence: PASS with non-blocking precision note — clean checkout, literal implementation-selected commands, exit codes, results, and non-sensitive evidence are required to be recorded in implementation/PR record
task_validation.code_rabbit: N/A — disabled in core-config.yaml; manual review fallback present
task_validation.code_intelligence: Skipped: .aiox-core/core/code-intel is not present, per task's auto-skip-if-unavailable instruction
task_validation.anti_hallucination: PASS — no fixed versions, runtime, CLI language, ORM, migration framework, schema table name, or deployment choice is invented

po_master_checklist_categories.notes: Clean-checkout bootstrap, dependency/lockfile documentation, and local commands are required; exact implementation choices remain open as authorized.
PostgreSQL setup, empty baseline, normal migration rerun, and DB-dependent tests are explicit. Deployment and hosted infrastructure are correctly excluded.
No external provider is introduced; database credentials are local/external and must not be committed.
No UI is in scope; future Next.js interface remains read-only and sequenced after operational CLI journeys.
Executor, independent quality gate, tools, and supporting reviews are assigned; DB work mapping is correct.
No dependency is consistent with story 1.2 as the first executable backlog increment.
Greenfield foundation story; brownfield-only controls do not apply.
Enabling infrastructure only; no domain behavior, UI, or unapproved functionality is added.
Exact chosen install/CLI/DB/migration/test commands, observed versions, and non-sensitive local evidence are required in project instructions and implementation record.
No premature hosting or extensibility scope; the story documents that selected tools are implementation choices, not product-approved versions.

nice_to_have.summary: Name a persistent path for the local validation evidence when implementation structure is selected.
nice_to_have.detail: The story requires commands, exit codes, outcomes, and non-sensitive evidence in the implementation/PR record, but intentionally does not prescribe a repository path before the source tree and tooling are chosen.
nice_to_have.impact: Non-blocking; does not prevent reproducing the verification steps or implementing the story.

score_rationale: 9/10: all prior blocking gaps are resolved. The minimum CLI contract is observable, the schema boundary is limited to migration control, empty-database application and repeat execution against an already-migrated database are separate and unambiguous, and tasks/Dev Notes/testing plus DB-specialist ownership are present. One point is conservatively deducted because the exact persistent path for local evidence is deferred to the implementation record/PR rather than fixed now; this does not block a GO.
